summary: REVISE. The exact required SHA was audited. The central P2–P11 reduction is sound over F_p² for every prime p and integer 100<d<p, including the conversion from arbitrarily many components to one degree-at-most-d polynomial. Acceptance fails because the exact fixed-θ conclusion and P12 omit the RDθ trigger, and the exponent ledger contains a concrete false unqualified Θ(s²D) claim plus several repairable source and scope overstatements. There is no fatal counterexample to the properly thresholded conditional theorem. The unconditional verified exponent remains 1/3; conditional 1−η is an improvement only for 0<η<2/3.
verified_exponent: Unconditional 1/3; conditional on triggered RDθ, exponent 1−η for fixed η>0, stronger than 1/3 exactly when 0<η<2/3.
